deploymentIdentity.method: operator-secret-authenticated read of /api/internal/inspection/release-identity through vercel curl with the station CRON_SECRET (the alias is behind Vercel Authentication)
deploymentIdentity.note: Both hashes were recomputed from the stored connection strings with sha256(JSON.stringify(<host without -pooler>:<port||5432><pathname>)) and had to match before any database write was allowed.

effectiveRuntimeConfig.note: The G1 switches read false and no G1 release manifest exists on the station, so G1-gated generation stayed off. No pins were invented and no G1 flag was changed. This config was read back from the redeployment after CRON_SECRET rotation; the deployment used the same commit.
